Chapter 1008: Chapter 19 Unprecedented Physical Body Divine Ability (Please Subscribe)_2

But now, Lin Yuan’s foundational rule comprehension has reached a magnitude of ten million. Even after condensing another Seed of the Fierce Sun, it would only enhance the magnitude of rule comprehension by a mere one ten-millionth…

The most critical point is that currently, condensing another Seed of the Fierce Sun requires far more effort and mental energy compared to when the first Seed was condensed.

It is precisely for this reason that the powerhouses of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, upon stepping into the Self-Dao Realm and condensing hundreds to thousands of Seeds of the Fierce Sun, tend to pause this endeavor and redirect their focus toward cultivating rule comprehension.

A rare few ambitious individuals, however, will persist in condensing more Seeds of the Fierce Sun, driven by the aspiration to transform their physical bodies into the Solar Divine Body.

The Solar Divine Body is indisputably the most formidable physique within the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Currently, Lin Yuan’s physical body has already begun the transformation into the Solar Divine Body, and the benefits associated with condensing the Seeds of the Fierce Sun have been fully realized. This is why Lord Qingfen has made such a suggestion.

Continuing to devote effort and focus on condensing more Seeds of the Fierce Sun now appears somewhat counterproductive.

“Lord Marquis, is it true that condensing the Seeds of the Fierce Sun only has these two benefits?” Lin Yuan thought for a moment and asked.

This question arose due to the number of Seeds of the Fierce Sun he had condensed when his physical body began the transformation into the Solar Divine Body—exactly 3,333.

Lin Yuan was utterly familiar with this number. Beyond it, he speculated that 33,333 Seeds of the Fierce Sun might lead to new changes.

Moreover, at present, Lin Yuan had nearly 20,000 Seeds of the Fierce Sun within his body. He vaguely sensed that condensing more Seeds of the Fierce Sun would yield immense benefits.

It was as if, halfway down a path, fragments of the ‘destination’ began to come into view.

“Not entirely.” Lord Qingfen paused briefly before explaining:

“It is said that the royal lineage of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, blessed with powerful bloodlines, can easily condense Seed after Seed of the Fierce Sun. Coupled with the Solar Radiance Blessing, the difficulty of condensing these Seeds is drastically reduced. When their Seeds of the Fierce Sun reach a certain quantity, they gain certain abilities.”

“Solar Radiance Blessing?” Lin Yuan sharply picked up on this statement.

“The royal lineage of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country… their origins are unfathomable. Every royal member of the ancient country can bask in the radiance of the Fierce Sun. Even without doing anything, they can autonomously condense Seeds of the Fierce Sun.”

“That is why the royal lineage dares to pursue more Seeds of the Fierce Sun. As for beings outside the royal family, they do not need to waste effort on this.”

Lord Qingfen elaborated.

This is the most rational course of action. The royal lineage of the ancient country, shielded by their ancestral legacy, attempts to condense more Seeds of the Fierce Sun effortlessly.

Yet for regular beings, imitating such behavior would be rather foolish.

“What abilities are gained from condensing more Seeds of the Fierce Sun?” Lin Yuan pondered briefly before questioning.

Although condensing Seeds of the Fierce Sun had undeniably become far more challenging compared to the beginning, Lin Yuan had managed to condense one Seed per breath initially.

Even though the pace had now slowed, it remained considerable.

“The specifics of these abilities, I am uncertain. These secrets are reserved for the royal lineage of the ancient country.”

Lord Qingfen shook his head and replied: “If you intend to condense more Seeds of the Fierce Sun, you may proceed, but do not exhaust all your mental energy. Rule comprehension—a grasp of the Dao—is the foundation above all.”

Seeing Lin Yuan’s evident interest in condensing the Seeds of the Fierce Sun, Lord Qingfen did not obstruct him. After all, anyone capable of condensing tens of thousands of Seeds before the age of 500 would grow curious about the powers of the ancient country’s royal lineage.

“The comprehension of rules and the Dao is no less powerful than the path of the ancient country’s royal lineage. Even Heavenly Venerate-level experts are able to hold their ground against the might of the ancient nation.”

Lord Qingfen reminded earnestly.

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan responded with determination.

Be it rule comprehension or the condensation of more Seeds of the Fierce Sun, he was determined to pursue both.

The process of condensing Seeds of the Fierce Sun wasn’t difficult for Lin Yuan—he could accomplish it gradually.

“If you still have questions, feel free to ask.” Lord Qingfen gazed at Lin Yuan.

“Lord Marquis, I wish to know—the Eternal Sun hanging above the heavens, what level of existence is it truly on…” Lin Yuan voiced his greatest curiosity.

Since arriving in this Fang Yuan World, the Eternal Sun had continuously illuminated everything.

Lin Yuan speculated that the Eternal Sun might very well be a thirteenth-level temporal entity, but he had no confirmation.

“It must not be spoken of.” Lord Qingfen’s expression grew solemn, offering no elaboration.

Seeing this, Lin Yuan felt a chilling apprehension.

Lord Qingfen’s demeanor seemed as if merely mentioning it would attract attention?

But this place was the Sky Burning Court—Lord Qingfen’s domain. If Lin Yuan refrained from speaking the name, who could possibly discover it?

There was only one possibility—that the Eternal Sun itself could perceive it.

No matter how far, no matter where—as long as the name of the Eternal Sun was uttered, the entity could somehow sense it.

Judging by Lord Qingfen’s evident wariness, it seemed probable that this perception wasn’t mere awareness but also the capacity to act through the faintest connection.

Of course, as a marquis of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Lord Qingfen counted as ‘one of its own.’ Even if the Eternal Sun intervened, it would not strike lethally but likely impose a reprimand.

“Remember, within the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, you must never mention that entity’s name.” Lord Qingfen warned gravely.

“Understood.” Lin Yuan nodded earnestly.

In truth, back in the Yu Family, Lin Yuan had noticed that people rarely dared to even utter the existence of the Eternal Sun. At the time, he had merely presumed it was a typical manifestation of reverence.

Now it was clear: this wasn’t reverence—it was fear.

“The path you will walk, I can at most give a few pointers. As for how you navigate it, that is ultimately up to you.”

Lord Qingfen spoke: “I will provide all the resources you need during your cultivation period, and I will do my best to resolve any doubts you encounter in your training. But the main journey is yours alone to complete.”

“Thank you, Lord Marquis.” Lin Yuan expressed his gratitude.

“You are my disciple; there is no need for such formalities.” Lord Qingfen waved dismissively. “Also, refrain from traveling too far in the near future. The Qingfen Domain has become rather unsettled recently.”

“If there is anything that needs to be done, have someone else take care of it.”

“Yes, understood.” Lin Yuan promptly agreed.

Even if he were allowed to travel far, Lin Yuan had no intention of doing so.

“Unsettled?” Lin Yuan mused silently, recalling countless transmissions and legacies from the Sky Burning Court. He too recognized that this Fang Yuan World was not solely dominated by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country alone. There existed other ancient countries as well.

These ancient countries were colossal entities, each standing as a monument across the vast Fang Yuan World. Between them, peace was far from guaranteed.

…

Lord Qingfen exchanged a few more words with Lin Yuan before departing.

As for the Sky Burning Court, it continued to serve as Lin Yuan’s residence.

“These cultivation resources…”

Soon enough, Lin Yuan received vast amounts of cultivation resources dispatched by Lord Qingfen.

Time passed quietly.

In the blink of an eye, days had elapsed.

“Physical Body Divine Ability…”

Seated cross-legged, Lin Yuan could sense the profound bloodline pulses within his body. Numerous primordial essences stirred nervously, intertwining and colliding.

“The condensation of Physical Body Divine Ability has begun.” Lin Yuan observed intently.

This Fang Yuan World was extraordinarily endowed, its bloodline powers unmatched. The resulting Physical Body Divine Ability would likely provide Lin Yuan with tremendous assistance.

Up until now, Lin Yuan had already awakened six types of Physical Body Divine Abilities, each of which had enormously boosted his inner foundations.

Even the seemingly least useful ability, ‘Mountain Shifter,’ had directly raised Lin Yuan’s combat skill in physical body confrontations and deepened his comprehension of the rules of force.

Hence, Lin Yuan held great anticipation for the Physical Body Divine Ability about to be awakened.

Much like the comprehension of rules, Physical Body Divine Abilities could also be carried back into the Chaos Void, where they would universally benefit his countless true selves, avatars, and Primordial Spirit projections.

“Hmm?”

“This time, the formation of the Physical Body Divine Ability will take two millennia?”

Lin Yuan carefully perceived, studying the tempering process of primordial bloodline essences deep within him and roughly deducing the time required for the Physical Body Divine Ability to emerge.

Having awakened six such abilities already, Lin Yuan was highly experienced in these matters.

“Such a long duration?”

Lin Yuan felt a twinge of surprise.

Back when condensing the Divine Ability [Elemental Body], Lin Yuan had already realized that the awakening of Physical Body Divine Abilities required long periods of gestation.

The reason lay in the incredible complexity of bloodlines within any living being—a multitude beyond counting. Identifying the most formidable bloodline and condensing it into a corresponding Divine Ability?

It was no simple matter.
